explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The statement only says that the underlying ring hom of `quotientMap` is the corresponding `Ideal.Quotient.lift`, so its content lies in the library's definitions. Mathlib has `Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_apply`, which states the same fact pointwise for general `liftₐ`. There is no ring-hom-level `liftₐ_toRingHom` lemma: I grepped for `liftₐ_toRingHom` and `toRingHom_liftₐ` with no results. I also read `Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Quotient/Operations.lean` (`liftₐ`, `liftₐ_apply`, `liftₐ_comp`).
